UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 973 
Jesduvroq (daprodustat) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-144070  
Guideline Name 
Jesduvroq (daprodustat)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Community & State Arizona  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
4/1/2024  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Jesduvroq  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of chronic kidney disease (CKD)  
 
AND 


--- PDF page 974 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 974 
 
2 - Patient has been on dialysis for at least 4 months  
 
AND 
 
3 - Adequate iron stores confirmed by BOTH of the following:  
• 
Patient's ferritin level is greater than 100 mcg/L (micrograms per liter)  
• 
Patient's transferrin saturation (TSAT) is greater than 20%  
 
AND 
 
4 - Hemoglobin level is less than 11 g/dL (grams per deciliter)  
 
AND 
 
5 - Trial and failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of the following:  
• 
Epogen  
• 
Procrit  
• 
Retacrit  
 
AND 
 
6 - Prescribed by or in consultation with ONE of the following:  
• 
Hematologist  
• 
Nephrologist  
 
AND 
 
7 - Patient is NOT on concurrent treatment with an erythropoietin stimulating agent [ESA] 
(e.g., Aranesp, Epogen, Procrit)  
 
Product Name:Jesduvroq  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  


--- PDF page 975 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 975 
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., increase in hemoglobin)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Hemoglobin level does not exceed 12 g/dL (grams per deciliter)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Adequate iron stores confirmed by BOTH of the following:  
• 
Patient's ferritin level is greater than 100 mcg/L (micrograms per liter)  
• 
Patient's transferrin saturation (TSAT) is greater than 20%  
 
AND 
 
4 - Patient is NOT on concurrent treatment with an erythropoietin stimulating agent [ESA] 
(e.g., Aranesp, Epogen, Procrit)

Date  
Notes

New program - C&S to align with AZM.
